definitions.explanation: Dirty water that flows from houses and buildings into drains.
The system of pipes and channels that carries away sewage.

examples.japanese: {下水|げすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まっている→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整備|せいび}されている→整備する：04037_seibi⟧。
examples.english: This area has a well-developed sewage system.

notes:
{下水|げすい} covers both the wastewater itself (sense 1) and the system that carries it away (sense 2). A compound of {下|げ} (lower) + {水|すい} (water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧: sewer system
- {下水|げすい}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: sewage treatment
- {下水|げすい}⟦{処理場|しょりじょう}→処理場：09653_shorijou⟧: sewage treatment plant
- {下水|げすい}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧: sewer construction
- {下水|げすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{詰|つ}まる→詰まる：02079_tsumaru⟧: sewer gets clogged

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上水|じょうすい}→上水：20521_jousui⟧: clean water supply (the opposite — {上|じょう} means "upper/clean")
- ⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧: water supply system

USAGE:
⟦{下水道|げすいどう}→下水道：09632_gesuidou⟧ (with {道|どう}) specifically means the sewer system/infrastructure, while {下水|げすい} alone can mean both the water and the system.
